content:
jamie: Heads-up — release cutoff in ~2h. Please get any bump PRs and changelog entries in before 14:00 UTC. If you're waiting on reviews, ping a reviewer now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: quick Q — is the cutoff branch `release/main` or `release/patch` for 3.4.x? i have a small docs bump and a tiny bugfix that needs backporting.

jamie: Both. New features -> `release/main` (feature window closed). Bugfixes and docs -> `release/patch/3.4.x`. Backports should target the patch branch; label `backport-needed` on the PR.

sara: FYI `changelog-lint` is failing on my PR, it wants the component tag. Error: `Missing component tag in changelog entry (component: infra|runtime|api)`.

jamie: for the lint, use the one-line shape: `Component: short description (PR link)`. Example: `runtime: fix kv-cache eviction race (PR #4212)` — one sentence, no bullet lists.

linda: where's the canonical template? I keep seeing slightly different examples.

jamie: canonical template — https://intranet.local/repo/release/CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.md  (also pinned in #eng-releases pinned). Copy-paste the header then the one-liner body. Please include a link to the PR and the author.

sara: posting the failing snippet here so folks see the exact shape:

```
- Missing: `component: short description (PR #xxxx)`
- Allowed: `api: return structured error for gRPC timeout (PR #4321) — @sara`
```

alex: got it. Also — can we PLEASE avoid long prose in changelog entries? product copied a 3-paragraph explanation into the entry in the last release and linted-out on purpose.

jamie: agreed. We're trying to keep the changelog machine-readable and concise for release notes automation. If you need longer context, put it in the PR body or docs site and link it.

linda: bump PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5001  — changelog added, tag `docs`, `release/patch/3.4.x` target. pls review.

alex: reviewing now. if anyone else wants a fast reviewer, add `@jamie` and `@linda` to the review request. Doing one quick pass.

sara: the CI job that enforces changelog shape is `ci-changelog-lint`. If it fails, the PR will be blocked at merge. We can run it locally with `make changelog-lint` if you want to iterate.

jamie: Operational note: we'll cut the release branch at 14:00 UTC. After that, only emergency bugfixes accepted via explicit oncall approval. If you think your change is critical after cutoff, please escalate in this thread and add `oncall@redwood` in the PR description.

deploy-bot: Release window reminder scheduled for 2068123500 (10 minutes before cutoff).

alex: quick checklist for everyone before you post a changelog entry:
- component tag (api/infra/runtime/docs)
- one-line summary, PR link, author mention
- target branch set to `release/patch/3.4.x` if backport
- pass `ci-changelog-lint`

linda: thanks — fixing a small spacing nit on my entry, will re-run lint and update.

jamie: thanks all. If you can't get a reviewer in time, leave the entry as a draft in the changelog dir with `draft: true` in the PR body and we'll pull it in during the next patch. But prefer not to. :v:
